server.description: SEO content on your own site, with rankings, AI citations and traffic tracked.

protocolMetadata.instructions: Operate the user's RankControl workspace: AI-search visibility and citations, SEO content planning and publishing, backlinks and outreach, social repurposing, brand memory, analytics, and reports. Side-effect tools default to a dry run. When the user asked for the change, call them with confirm=true; ask first only when the request is unclear. Removals and team changes return an approval link for the workspace owner.

_published_faq.name: How do I add RankControl to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add RankControl to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.rctrl.com/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is RankControl MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 15, 2026, RankControl scores 100/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: How clear is RankControl's MCP tool documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 15, 2026, RankControl scores 82/100 in Manufact's review of tool titles, descriptions, input and output schemas, and behavior annotations. The review covers 112 of 112 discovered tools. The quality score measures documentation clarity; runtime behavior and marketplace readiness require separate checks.
